models.name: music_tracker__tags
models.description: Each record represents a unique tag.

columns.name: tags
columns.description: The tag of the music, excluding the Null tag.

columns.name: artist_released_most_singles
columns.description: The artist who has released the most singles with the tag, with ties broken by the ascending order of the artist

columns.name: total_album_download
columns.description: The total number of album downloads of the tag, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: amount_of_downloads
columns.description: The amount of downloads of the tag, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: oldest_single_release_title
columns.description: The title of the oldest single release of the tag, with ties broken by the ascending order of the single title.

columns.name: most_downloaded_release_title
columns.description: The title of the most downloaded release of the tag, with ties broken by the ascending order of the release title.
